hints: Intense geomagnetic storm: Dst minimum -213 nT.
Dst first fell below -50 nT 13 hours before reaching its minimum.
Dst was back above -30 nT 55 hours after the minimum.
Sustained southward Bz: 20 hours at or below -5 nT; minimum hourly Bz -31.8 nT.
Strongly southward Bz (hourly mean at or below -20 nT).
Fast solar wind: maximum hourly speed 711 km/s.
High solar wind dynamic pressure: up to 12.8 nPa (protons only).
Strong solar wind electric field: vBs up to 18.2 mV/m.

caveats: All values are hourly means in UTC; minute-level extremes are larger.
Solar wind and magnetic field values are shifted to the time they reach Earth (a delay of roughly 25 to 100 minutes depending on solar wind speed).
Bz is in GSM coordinates; negative Bz means southward.
63% of the solar wind plasma hours come from DSCOVR; the rest are OMNI hourly values.
Dst is provisional and may be revised by Kyoto.
